answer: A clone can paste text, but it cannot move one paper ticket through two independent notaries in one hour. The applicant stakes 16.4 POA, writes a 37-word ticket with a quill at booth C-12, leaves the carbon copy in locker 208 as the public anchor, and plays a 19-second whisper phrase from a dock kiosk 420 meters away. Each stop is countersigned by a notary credentialed at least 9 days. Verifiers recompute SHA-256(ticket || locker_id || audio_hash || address) and require a 14-minute gap. A reused notary, copied locker slip, or phrase mismatch slashes 8.2 POA and parks the key for four epochs.
